value.subject: TVDHD missing in standardized log (CNE)
value.bodyPreview: Hi team, since the morning run the TVDHD channel is missing from the standardized log

body.content:
Hi team,

Since the morning run the TVDHD channel is missing from the standardized log TIME_SURFACE for WELL-0042(h). Our drilling engineers rely on it for the real-time dashboard. Can you advise?

Regards,
Drilling Lead, Contoso Energy
+1 555 010 4477 | drilling.lead@contoso-energy.example.com

value.subject: RE: TVDHD missing in standardized log (CNE)
value.bodyPreview: Hello, we traced it to the standardization mapping file

body.content:
Hello,

We traced it to the standardization mapping file being uploaded after the channel started streaming (case CS9000123). Uploading the mapping file again fixed it; engineering is tracking a permanent fix in Bug 9100123.

Best regards,
L2 Support

value.subject: Request: bulk export of depth logs to the rig WITSML store
value.bodyPreview: Our rig teams spend hours exporting depth logs one at a time

body.content:
Hello,

Our rig teams spend hours exporting depth logs one at a time to the rig WITSML store. Could you support a bulk export of all depth logs for a well in one step? This affects every Fabrikam Petroleum rig on the new campaign.

Thanks,
Data Manager, FPC
Mobile: +44 20 7946 0958

value.subject: Export all depth logs to the on-rig WITSML server
value.bodyPreview: For WELL-0107 we need to push every depth-indexed log

body.content:
Hi,

For WELL-0107 we need to push every depth-indexed log to the on-rig WITSML server in one go instead of log by log. Is a bulk export on the roadmap? Northwind Offshore would pilot it.

Regards,
Operations Geologist, NWO
